text:
Anya Patel: Thanks everyone for the great all-hands today — quick follow-up thread for reliability + incident asks. recording + slides: https://notion.redwood/internals/allhands/2026-03-22 :spiral_note_pad:
Sam Torres: Can someone drop the RCA link here? I missed the detailed trace section.
Anya Patel: RCA is published: https://docs.redwood.company/incidents/RC-2026-03-22-KVcache-outage — sections: summary, timeline, root cause, mitigations.
Jordan Li: Thanks. Quick Q: does the RCA call out whether the fallback routing change will be in the next release or a hotfix?
Nora (Eng Lead): The plan in the RCA is a hotfix for the immediate fallback threshold (rolling today), and a follow-up release to add observability and a safer canary for the routing logic.
Lee Chen: Hotfix PR: https://git.redwood/infra/routers/pulls/324 — this adds a short-circuit when KV miss rate > 12% for 30s. Testing on staging now.
Marta Reyes: Heads-up from CS: two customers asked for status updates; can we get a one-paragraph blurb we can send?
Anya Patel: Suggested blurb: "We mitigated a transient KV cache regression that briefly increased latencies. A fix has been deployed and we have additional safeguards planned; no customer data was affected." Use and adapt as needed. :thumbsup:
Sam Torres: Action item register would help. Can we list owners + due dates here?
Anya Patel: Yep — I'll start a short register below. Please update if you own any item.
Nora (Eng Lead): Action 1 — deploy hotfix to all regions, monitor 48h. Owner: Lee Chen. Due: 2026-03-24.
Lee Chen: Acknowledged. I'll post canary metrics in #eng-oncall when the rollout hits 50% of traffic.
Nora (Eng Lead): Action 2 — add KV cache eviction metrics and alert (pager). Owner: Jordan Li. Due: 2026-04-02.
Jordan Li: Got it. I'll add dashboards + set pager threshold at 10% sustained miss rate over 5m.
Nora (Eng Lead): Action 3 — update runbook with rollback steps and safe canary procedure. Owner: Nora. Due: 2026-03-28.
Marta Reyes: Action 4 — customer comms draft and approval. Owner: Marta & Anya. Due: 2026-03-23 EOD.
Sam Torres: Action 5 — postmortem follow-up: verify we have end-to-end trace sampling in the failing flow. Owner: Sam. Due: 2026-03-30.
incident-bot: Incident RC-2026-03-22 status → mitigated. RCA published. https://docs.redwood.company/incidents/RC-2026-03-22-KVcache-outage
Lee Chen: Quick note — the hotfix includes this snippet in config:```
router.kv_miss.short_circuit.threshold=0.12
router.kv_miss.short_circuit.window_secs=30
```
Jordan Li: Will we need a migration or DB change?
Lee Chen: No DB changes. It's config + a small guard in the router path.
Anya Patel: Asks for leadership: if the 48h monitoring looks stable, do we still want to accelerate the roadmap item to harden routing?
Jordan Li: I recommend keeping the roadmap window but prioritizing the observability and canary automation earlier. We can push the harden task up by one sprint.
Nora (Eng Lead): Agreed. I'll propose shuffle in next Monday's sprint planning.
Marta Reyes: For customers who flagged latency spikes, can we offer a short postmortem link + a technical contact?
Anya Patel: Yes — provide RCA + support contact (cs+reliability@redwood.com).
Sam Torres: Anything else? If not, I'll close this thread after Lee confirms rollout complete.
Lee Chen: Rollout reached 100% at 1789501305, monitoring looks green. I'll post metrics shortly.
Anya Patel: Thanks everyone. Please update the RCA page with any follow-ups and mark actions done when complete.
Sam Torres: closing when metrics posted. :white_check_mark:
